Complex mixed drug. Lasts 24 hours.

Primary: Calm and positive. 7 Humanity armor: subtract it from any HL except new chrome; each HL that gets through ablates it by 1.

Secondary (DV15): All HL doubled (chrome included) unless dosed. Nightmares.

Recipe: Prime Time ×2, Black Lace ×2, binding chemical, synth-honey.
